title: The prognostic and neuroendocrine implications of SLC25A29-mediated biomass signature in prostate cancer.
authors: Wu, Chia-Chang; Hu, Su-Wei; Dong, Shao-Wei; Tzou, Kai-Yi; Li, Chien Hsiu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究前列腺癌中SLC25A29/E2F1/POLD1轴的预后与神经内分泌意义，虽涉及E2F1转录因子与POLD1的调控关系，但核心是临床预后与肿瘤机制，缺乏TF-DNA结合位点预测、互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Dysregulated solutes are linked to cancer progression, with associated carriers being potential targets for prognosis and treatment. Androgen deprivation therapy (ADT) is essential for prostate cancer (PCa) progression, but secondary resistance often leads to androgen-independent tumor growth, necessitating new prognostic biomarkers. Transcriptome-based datasets identify SLC25A29, an arginine carrier, as upregulated in PCa, correlating with metastatic features and serving as a high-risk prognostic factor, particularly in castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC). Molecular simulations indicate that SLC25A29-mediated pathways contribute to mitochondrial metabolism and redox homeostasis, implicating POLD1 regulation and suggesting a link to ferroptosis. Further analysis reveals that SLC25A29 may transactivate POLD1 via E2F1, as shown by RNA-seq profiling of E2F1 knockdown in CRPC-related cells, which demonstrated reduced POLD1 expression. Clinical and cellular studies confirm that SLC25A29, E2F1, and POLD1 levels positively correlate with pathological features, with their downstream effectors serving as prognosis signatures. The SLC25A29/E2F1/POLD1 axis is associated with neuroendocrine PCa (NEPC) development, indicating its role in response to androgen receptor inhibition. Downregulation of E2F1 not only decreases POLD1 levels but also reduces NEPC-related markers. These findings support the SLC25A29/E2F1/POLD1 axis as a prognostic tool for CRPC and NEPC, and targeting E2F1 may offer a therapeutic strategy to disrupt SLC25A29-mediated PCa progression.
abstract_zh: 失调的溶质与癌症进展相关，其相关载体是预后和治疗的潜在靶点。雄激素剥夺疗法 (androgen deprivation therapy, ADT) 对前列腺癌 (prostate cancer, PCa) 进展至关重要，但继发性耐药常导致雄激素非依赖性肿瘤生长，因此需要新的预后生物标志物。基于转录组的数据集将SLC25A29（一种精氨酸载体）鉴定为在PCa中上调，与转移特征相关，并作为高风险预后因素，尤其在去势抵抗性前列腺癌 (castration-resistant prostate cancer, CRPC) 中。分子模拟表明，SLC25A29介导的途径有助于线粒体代谢和氧化还原稳态，涉及POLD1调控，并提示与铁死亡 (ferroptosis) 相关。进一步分析揭示，SLC25A29可能通过E2F1反式激活POLD1，这通过CRPC相关细胞中E2F1敲低的RNA-seq分析得到证实，显示POLD1表达降低。临床和细胞研究确认，SLC25A29、E2F1和POLD1水平与病理特征正相关，其下游效应因子作为预后特征。SLC25A29/E2F1/POLD1轴与神经内分泌前列腺癌 (neuroendocrine PCa, NEPC) 发展相关，表明其在响应雄激素受体抑制中的作用。E2F1的下调不仅降低POLD1水平，还减少NEPC相关标志物。这些发现支持SLC25A29/E2F1/POLD1轴作为CRPC和NEPC的预后工具，且靶向E2F1可能提供一种治疗策略，以破坏SLC25A29介导的PCa进展。
